name: HUUTOPUSSI
description: Huutopussi (Finnish for 'Bidding Bag') is a prestigious Finnish trick-taking game for four players in partnerships. It is an evolution of 'Marjapussi', adding a complex bidding phase where partnerships compete for the right to exchange cards and set the contract. It is famous for its 'Marriage' system, where declaring a King-Queen pair of the same suit establishes the trump and awards points.

content.text: Huutopussi (Finnish for 'Bidding Bag') is a prestigious Finnish trick-taking game for four players in partnerships. It is an evolution of 'Marjapussi', adding a complex bidding phase where partnerships compete for the right to exchange cards and set the contract. It is famous for its 'Marriage' system, where declaring a King-Queen pair of the same suit establishes the trump and awards points.
Derived from the older game 'Marjapussi'. It includes influences from Russian games like 'Tysiacha' (1000). The current 'Huutopussi' name and rules stabilized in the mid-20th century.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: Ace (11), 10 (10), King (4), Queen (3), Jack (2), 9-2 (0). Note: 10 is higher than King.

items.text: Marjapussi: The parent game without bidding.
Lanttipussi: A variant where players 'pay' for bidding failures.
Porvoon Huutopussi: Regional variant with different point values.
